scope: Current-token timing source/provenance review and synthetic array packing only. No new timing outputs, checkpoint forwards, or probe fits accessed/run.

findings.detail: Recipient previous_states is cached point0. Edited current h1 is built once from old FP32 recipient/donor/same-label states and saved coordinate/v/q. replay_upper processes only L2-L4 from recipient previous upper states; L1 and input embedding are not rerun.
Each common early/late condition receives byte-identical h1; per-case h1 SHA, checker and defining-probe equality are enforced. Early full-L1 and late layer1 full swaps likewise inject identical h1.

All11 old common late conditions are reexecuted and compared to old logits at the existing1e-4 bound; early no-op is checked against late and original native logits at1e-4, with current states at2e-5. Argmax drift is reported and not filtered.

Treatment/random matching uses the injected first-layer delta only. Replayed upper consequences and full-state delta are separately retained without rescaling; auxiliary upper-layer swaps may have zero L1 delta but a nonzero full-state delta.

Each source cell SHA/checkpoint/data and saved direction are verified; opaque node IDs bind recipient/donor/actualCF to the correct old catalog per task. Input audit already resolves a valid same-label donor for every old pair, so current availability=True is justified by that required input audit.

12early replay input blocks align with repeated recipient previous states.28suffix-query blocks use condition-major stacking and the same recipient suffix, then reshape in the same order. ActualCF is reused separately.29CSV rows are written case-major per saved pair ID; synthetic marker pack/reshape passed.

Late layer swaps1..4 replace exactly corresponding h_l. Metadata layer is the actual swapped index, while probe_layer remains1. Payload dimensions distinguish rank-one(1), whole single-layer(256), whole-four-layer(1024) controls and natural inputs(0).

All rows retain local-only desired count=recipient total+sign. Full-state donor reference uses donor native logits/count, which may remain recipient count in matched pairs. ActualCF count uses the local-only goal; these references are kept separate.

Only exact old weight/bias and raw direction are loaded; no Ridge/threshold/alpha fitting exists in this stage. Old coordinates and all8old random vectors are reused; source SHA is computed once per cell.

Runner fixes old2thread settings, CUDA matmul and cuDNN TF32=False, deterministiccuDNN=True; standalone failed-default and restored-context checks remain recorded in replay_preflight.json with unchanged tolerances.

limitations: The label is coupled to local token order/rank and mixed states can be off manifold. A timing effect identifies this intervention path, not an abstract predicate or natural one-dimensional mechanism.
Whole lower-layer donor replay uses recipient previous upper states and is not a donor-prefix replacement. Whole-four-state wiring controls remain distinct.
This review does not independently reproduce future timing outcomes; post-run saved-array/endpoint verification is still required.
